verdict.rationale: Twilio Video is a real-time video API/SDK platform. Comparable real-time communications platforms can ship AI agent features that consume MCP tools, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows Twilio Video acting as an MCP client or connecting to MCP servers. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes cover AI-readable documentation, not MCP client capability, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
